message: OptiFine and Embeddium both patch renderer internals and can conflict.
suggestedFix: Remove OptiFine from the pack or disable Embeddium advanced renderer hooks.

message: KubeJS and GroovyScript may both inject recipe mutations during reload.
suggestedFix: Keep recipe mutations in one scripting mod and disable duplicate scripts in the other.

message: ModernFix and Starlight can produce timing-sensitive worldgen init order issues in some packs.
suggestedFix: Update both mods to latest versions and disable async world init in one mod if crashes persist.

message: Multiple profiler mods can increase overhead during diagnostics.
suggestedFix: Enable only one profiling mod for routine play sessions.
